title: Football
description: VR football: swing a controller through the floating ball and put it through the other gate. Hit the ball to kick off; first to 5 or 3:00, golden goal on a tie. Colocation-ready.
author: theprototype

data.title: Football — read me first
data.text:
Hit the ball through the **other** team's gate.
- **Match Rules** holds the settings — select it, ⓘ tab: first to N goals, match length, own goals, golden goal.
- **Football rules** is the code that *decides* — who scored, what a goal is worth, when it is over. Double-click to read or change it (Ctrl+S).
- The ball, the gates and the kick-off are the **engine** (read-only; *Make editable copy* forks it).

data.title: Match settings
data.text: The ball is wired into **Match Rules**, which sits on the pitch. Its numbers are what the rules read.

data.title: Football engine — the ball, gates, kick-off, the sheet
The engine
data.text: What the rules call as **kit.football.*** — it sees the ball enter a gate and does what the rules decide on every screen. Double-click to read it.

data.title: Goals
data.text: A goal decided by the rules flashes the net it went into. The game shell follows the match (start → playing, the whistle → results).

data.title: Gates & buttons
data.text: Each **Team Gate** names a gate sensor; the **Match Button** nodes put the physical and HUD buttons to work (join, start, rematch).

data.title: Lamps & board
data.text: Twenty lamps light with the score; the scoreboard and the sheet read the engine.

elements.label: Red vs Blue. Knock the floating ball through the other team's gate.
Hit the ball: swing a controller through it (desktop: walk into it or click it).
Score in the OTHER team's gate: red attacks the blue gate, blue attacks the red.
First to 5 goals, or the higher score after 3:00. Level at the whistle: golden goal.
After a goal the ball goes back to the centre; the team that conceded kicks off.
No need to pick a side: hit the ball or press Start and you join the smaller team.
Pause: P  ·  Esc leaves play  ·  In VR the Y button switches Edit / Interact
Knock the ball into the other gate  ·  first to 5 or 3:00  ·  P pauses
